description: Weekly residential and commercial solid waste collection schedule managed by the City Environment & Natural Resources Office (CENRO) Roxas City.
steps: Monday & Thursday: Brgy. Baybay, Culasi, Libas, Barra (Biodegradable Waste)
Tuesday & Friday: Brgy. Lawaan, Tanque, Inzo Arnaldo, Tiza, Banica (Biodegradable Waste)
Daily Morning & Evening: Teodoro Arcenas Trade Center (TATC) Market & Downtown Commercial District
Saturday & Sunday: Coastal Cleanup & Special Eco-Corridor Collection
requirements: Strict waste segregation at source (Biodegradable vs. Non-biodegradable vs. Hazardous).
Place tied garbage bins or trash bags at collection points only between 6:00 AM - 7:30 AM.

quickInfo.whoCanApply: All Roxas City residents & business owners

sources.name: Republic Act No. 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act)
Roxas City Ecological Solid Waste Management Board

service: Mangrove Reforestation & Coastal Greenbelt Tree Planting
description: Community environmental initiative supporting coastal resilience through mangrove seedling donation, technical planting guidance, and protected coastal zone monitoring in Palina and Sibuyan waterways.
steps: Submit letter of intent or tree-planting request to CENRO Roxas City.
Receive briefing on designated mangrove planting zones (Palina, Culasi, or Dayao estuaries).
Claim mangrove propagules/seedlings at the City Eco-Park nursery.
Participate in guided coastal planting activity with community fisherfolk stewards.
requirements: Identification of participating organization or institution

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Schools, NGOs, civic organizations, and youth groups

sources.name: CENRO Roxas City Coastal Resource Management Unit
